investigations.question: What holds the pilot at/below x~2055 for 90s with only one early death (timeout at maxX 2055, crown x=3000, frontier at x~2000-2061: roller beat x=2000 plus deck-4 transition at x~2061)? Stored evidence has no input history, no position/stall trace, no death cause, no hazard-phase data, no per-run retention, and no gameplay frames, so pilot failure cannot be distinguished from level-design failure.
investigations.smallestNextStep: Bounded rerun with input history, a position/stall trace, death events (hazard id/cause/phase for the x=357 death), and retained gameplay frames of the roller/deck-4 frontier including roller phase, the deck-4 landing, and telegraph visibility in the frames around the stall; repeat across fresh starts/phases. Only if the stall repeats in captured play may a level edit be proposed.

fixes.smallestFix: Resolve INV-1 first (capture the stall cause and the x~2000-2061 frontier encounter; no level edit before that). Then, only on captured route evidence: diagnose repetitive play from route evidence, not paint -- add a route decision or set piece to the flagged stretch, and only repaint if the build report cannot justify the single-key look as art direction.
fixes.recheck: Re-run the full critic with route coverage past x=2055: route evidence (not paint) must show a new decision in the flagged stretch, or the build report must carry the art-direction exception.
fixes.limitations: Corroborated by vote count plus cross-run repeat plus deck flag, but the panel judged staged stills (JPG binaries not retained), 2 of the 5 stills depict unplayed sections, and no route-connectivity/waiting-time telemetry is stored; four personas judging one summary are four model perspectives, not four playtests.
fixes.alternativeCause: Stall artifact: the panel may be reading thin evidence (3 played stills plus staged stills of never-reached sections) and the timeout-shortened telemetry rather than a played repeated stretch. If INV-1 shows the pilot cannot progress for policy reasons, the flat read still needs a fresh capture with real route coverage.
